title: Differential maps in the quotient conormal sequence (Stacks Tag 00RU)
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $\mathfrak a\subseteq B$ be an ideal, and put $C=B/\mathfrak a$. For the Kähler differentials and universal derivations of [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], **Stacks Tag 00RU (lemma-differential-seq)** identifies the canonical maps $$\mathfrak a/\mathfrak a^2\longrightarrow C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}\longrightarrow\Omega_{C/A}$$ by $$a\bmod\mathfrak a^2\longmapsto1\otimes\mathrm da,\qquad c\otimes\mathrm db\longmapsto c\,\mathrm d\bar b,$$ where $\bar b$ is the class of $b$ in $C$; this sequence is exact at $C\otimes_B\Omega_{B/A}$ and surjective onto $\Omega_{C/A}$.
